spec.description: Logins, failures and probes from the OpenSSH server journal.

spec.title: Logins
spec.description: Accepted authentications, one per connection, excluding the accounts listed in the **Service accounts** variable.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Logins
spec.description: Service accounts are on the Service tab.

spec.expr: sum by (user, method) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__interval]))

spec.description: One row per account, method, source and host. A password login is orange, and red for `root`. Service accounts are on the Service tab.

spec.expr: sum by (key, user, method, mrisk, ip, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` | label_format mrisk=`{{ if and (eq .user "root") (eq .method "password") }}password!root{{ else }}{{ .method }}{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.method}} · {{.ip}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` | label_format mrisk=`{{ if and (eq .user "root") (eq .method "password") }}password!root{{ else }}{{ .method }}{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.method}} · {{.ip}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Users
spec.description: Distinct non-service accounts that authenticated.

spec.expr: count(count by (user) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failures
spec.description:
Every rejection sshd logs, by what stopped the connection.
- A rejected credential is named by the method it offered.
- One connection can raise more than one: an unknown account counts once as `Invalid user` and again for each credential it then offers.

spec.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Failed ` | pattern `Failed <method> for <_>` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Invalid user ` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^error: maximum authentication attempts` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange)` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\]` [$__interval]))

spec.description:
One row per source, account, reason and host, capped at the top 1000.
- `Reason` has the classes of the chart above.
- An account of `-` is a connection that failed before naming one.
- One rejected connection can log several lines.

spec.expr: topk(1000, sum by (key, ip, user, reason, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Failed |Invalid user |Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange|(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication|error: maximum authentication attempts|Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\])` | regexp `(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+) port ` | regexp `(?:user |for )(?P<user>[^ ]+) (?:from |[0-9a-fA-F.:]+ port)` | label_format user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`, reason=`{{ if hasPrefix "Failed " __line__ }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^Failed (\\S+) .*$" __line__ "Failed ${1}" }}{{ else if hasPrefix "Invalid user " __line__ }}Invalid user{{ else if contains "maximum authentication" __line__ }}Max auth tries{{ else if contains "Timeout before" __line__ }}Grace timeout{{ else if hasPrefix "Connection " __line__ }}Closed pre-auth{{ else }}Negotiation{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.ip}} · {{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range])))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Failed |Invalid user |Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange|(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication|error: maximum authentication attempts|Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\])` | regexp `(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+) port ` | regexp `(?:user |for )(?P<user>[^ ]+) (?:from |[0-9a-fA-F.:]+ port)` | label_format user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`, reason=`{{ if hasPrefix "Failed " __line__ }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^Failed (\\S+) .*$" __line__ "Failed ${1}" }}{{ else if hasPrefix "Invalid user " __line__ }}Invalid user{{ else if contains "maximum authentication" __line__ }}Max auth tries{{ else if contains "Timeout before" __line__ }}Grace timeout{{ else if hasPrefix "Connection " __line__ }}Closed pre-auth{{ else }}Negotiation{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.ip}} · {{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000 and on (key) topk(1000, sum by (key, ip, user, reason, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Failed |Invalid user |Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange|(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication|error: maximum authentication attempts|Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\])` | regexp `(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+) port ` | regexp `(?:user |for )(?P<user>[^ ]+) (?:from |[0-9a-fA-F.:]+ port)` | label_format user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`, reason=`{{ if hasPrefix "Failed " __line__ }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^Failed (\\S+) .*$" __line__ "Failed ${1}" }}{{ else if hasPrefix "Invalid user " __line__ }}Invalid user{{ else if contains "maximum authentication" __line__ }}Max auth tries{{ else if contains "Timeout before" __line__ }}Grace timeout{{ else if hasPrefix "Connection " __line__ }}Closed pre-auth{{ else }}Negotiation{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.ip}} · {{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range])))

spec.description:
One row per host whose sshd logged something. **Logins**, **Users**, **Sources** and **Last login** exclude service accounts; **Service** counts them.

**Failed auth**, **Invalid users**, **Pre-auth aborts** and **Password auth** are the Overview stats per host. Each appears only once some host has one.

spec.expr: sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))

sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user =~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))

count by (hostname) (count by (hostname, user) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range])))

count by (hostname) (count by (hostname, ip) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range])))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Failed ` [$__range]))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Invalid user ` [$__range]))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted password ` [$__range]))

max by (hostname) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user !~ `^($service)$` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange|(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication|error: maximum authentication attempts|Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\])` [$__range]))

spec.title: Hosts
spec.description: Hosts whose sshd logged at least one line.

spec.expr: count(count by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

sum by (level) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `$noservice` !~ `$sessions` | label_format level=`{{ if hasPrefix "Accepted " __line__ }}info{{ else if or (hasPrefix "Failed " __line__) (hasPrefix "Invalid user " __line__) (contains "authentication failure" __line__) (contains "maximum authentication attempts" __line__) }}error{{ else if or (contains "[preauth]" __line__) (contains "Timeout before authentication" __line__) (contains "kex_exchange_identification" __line__) (contains "banner exchange" __line__) }}warning{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` [$__interval]))

spec.description:
Newest 1000 matching lines, service logins and session churn hidden by default.
- `info`: a login; `error`: a rejected credential or unknown account; `warning`: a connection dropped before authentication.
- The histogram above counts every match by the same levels, so the two disagree during a burst.

spec.expr: {hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `$noservice` !~ `$sessions` | label_format level=`{{ if hasPrefix "Accepted " __line__ }}info{{ else if or (hasPrefix "Failed " __line__) (hasPrefix "Invalid user " __line__) (contains "authentication failure" __line__) (contains "maximum authentication attempts" __line__) }}error{{ else if or (contains "[preauth]" __line__) (contains "Timeout before authentication" __line__) (contains "kex_exchange_identification" __line__) (contains "banner exchange" __line__) }}warning{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | drop detected_level, transport, systemd_unit | line_format `[2mhostname={{.hostname}}[0m {{__line__}}`

spec.title: Failed auth
spec.description: Credentials offered and rejected. A client retries up to `MaxAuthTries`, so one connection can log several.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Failed ` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.description: One row per service account, method, source and host. A password login is orange.

spec.expr: sum by (key, user, method, mrisk, ip, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user =~ `^($service)$` | label_format mrisk=`{{ if and (eq .user "root") (eq .method "password") }}password!root{{ else }}{{ .method }}{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.method}} · {{.ip}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user =~ `^($service)$` | label_format mrisk=`{{ if and (eq .user "root") (eq .method "password") }}password!root{{ else }}{{ .method }}{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.method}} · {{.ip}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

sum by (user, method) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user =~ `^($service)$` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Invalid users
spec.description: Connections asking for an account the host does not have — one line per connection.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Invalid user ` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pre-auth aborts
spec.description: Connections dropped before authentication finished: no shared host key or cipher, `LoginGraceTime` expired, `MaxAuthTries` exhausted, or the client hung up.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^(Unable to negotiate |error: kex_exchange_identification|banner exchange|(fatal: )?Timeout before authentication|error: maximum authentication attempts|Connection (closed|reset) by .*\[preauth\])` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Password auth
spec.description: Password logins that succeeded, service accounts included.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted password ` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Service
spec.description: Logins by the accounts listed in the **Service accounts** variable.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sshd.*"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^Accepted \S+ for ` | pattern `Accepted <method> for <user> from <ip> port <_>` | user =~ `^($service)$` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: SSH

spec.name: service
spec.label: Service accounts
spec.description: Accounts that reconnect on a schedule rather than being people, as a regex alternation. They are kept out of every audit panel and shown on the Service tab instead. Empty merges them back in.

spec.name: regexp
spec.label: Regexp
spec.description: Line filter applied to every panel. Matches are highlighted on the Logs tab.

spec.name: noservice
spec.label: Hide service
spec.description: Drop service-account logins from the Logs tab. A link into the Logs tab turns this off.

spec.name: sessions
spec.label: Hide sessions
spec.description: Drop the session open, close, disconnect and logout lines from the Logs tab.
